verses.text: He shall build Me a house, and I will set his throne upright for ever.
verses.display_text: He shall build Me a house, and I will set his throne upright for ever.

verses.text: I will be a Father unto him, and he shall be a son unto Me. I will not withdraw My mercy from him, as I withdrew it from those before you.
verses.display_text: I will be a Father unto him, and he shall be a son unto Me. I will not withdraw My mercy from him, as I withdrew it from those before you.

verses.text: I will make him secure in My house and in his kingdom for ever, and his throne shall be set upright for ever.’”
verses.display_text: I will make him secure in My house and in his kingdom for ever, and his throne shall be set upright for ever.’”

verses.text: Nathan spoke to David according to all these words and all this vision.
verses.display_text: Nathan spoke to David according to all these words and all this vision.

verses.text: King David went in and sat before the Lord. He said, “Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that Thou hast loved me for ever?
verses.display_text: King David went in and sat before the Lord. He said, “Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that Thou hast loved me for ever?

verses.text: These things became small before Thee, God, and Thou didst speak of Thy servant’s house far ahead. Thou didst look upon me as a human vision, and Thou didst exalt me, Lord God.
verses.display_text: These things became small before Thee, God, and Thou didst speak of Thy servant’s house far ahead. Thou didst look upon me as a human vision, and Thou didst exalt me, Lord God.

verses.text: What more can David add unto Thee in giving glory? Thou knowest Thy servant.
verses.display_text: What more can David add unto Thee in giving glory? Thou knowest Thy servant.

verses.text: Thou hast done all this greatness according to Thy heart.
verses.display_text: Thou hast done all this greatness according to Thy heart.

verses.text: Lord, there is none like Thee, and there is none besides Thee, according to all we have heard with our ears.
verses.display_text: Lord, there is none like Thee, and there is none besides Thee, according to all we have heard with our ears.

verses.text: There is no nation on the earth like Thy people Israel, whom God led to redeem a people for Himself, to make Himself a great and manifest name, driving nations out before Thy people whom Thou didst redeem from Egypt.
verses.display_text: There is no nation on the earth like Thy people Israel, whom God led to redeem a people for Himself, to make Himself a great and manifest name, driving nations out before Thy people whom Thou didst redeem from Egypt.

verses.text: Thou didst give Thy people Israel to Thyself as a people for ever, and Thou, O Lord, art their God.
verses.display_text: Thou didst give Thy people Israel to Thyself as a people for ever, and Thou, O Lord, art their God.

verses.text: Now, Lord, let Thy word which Thou didst speak to Thy servant and concerning his house be made secure for ever,
verses.display_text: Now, Lord, let Thy word which Thou didst speak to Thy servant and concerning his house be made secure for ever,

verses.text: while people say, ‘Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel,’ and let the house of David Thy servant be set upright before Thee.
verses.display_text: while people say, ‘Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel,’ and let the house of David Thy servant be set upright before Thee.

verses.text: For Thou, O Lord, didst open Thy servant’s ear to build him a house. Therefore Thy servant has found courage to pray before Thee.
verses.display_text: For Thou, O Lord, didst open Thy servant’s ear to build him a house. Therefore Thy servant has found courage to pray before Thee.

verses.text: Now, Lord, Thou art God, and Thou hast spoken these good things concerning Thy servant.
verses.display_text: Now, Lord, Thou art God, and Thou hast spoken these good things concerning Thy servant.

verses.text: Now Thou hast begun to bless Thy servant’s house, so it may remain before Thee for ever. For Thou, O Lord, hast blessed it; bless it for ever.”
verses.display_text: Now Thou hast begun to bless Thy servant’s house, so it may remain before Thee for ever. For Thou, O Lord, hast blessed it; bless it for ever.”

verses.text: After these things David struck the foreigners and routed them. He took Geth and its villages from the foreigners’ hand.
verses.display_text: After these things David struck the foreigners and routed them. He took Geth and its villages from the foreigners’ hand.

verses.text: He struck Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bringing gifts.
verses.display_text: He struck Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bringing gifts.

verses.text: David struck Adraazar king of Souba, Hemath, as he went to establish his hand upon the River Euphrates.
verses.display_text: David struck Adraazar king of Souba, Hemath, as he went to establish his hand upon the River Euphrates.

verses.text: David seized from them a thousand chariots, seven thousand horses, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David disabled all the chariots, but left a hundred chariots from them.
verses.display_text: David seized from them a thousand chariots, seven thousand horses, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David disabled all the chariots, but left a hundred chariots from them.

verses.text: The Syrian came from Damascus to help Adraazar king of Souba, and David struck twenty-two thousand men among the Syrian force.
verses.display_text: The Syrian came from Damascus to help Adraazar king of Souba, and David struck twenty-two thousand men among the Syrian force.

verses.text: David placed a garrison in Syria near Damascus, and they became servants to David, bringing gifts. The Lord kept saving David in all his journeys.
verses.display_text: David placed a garrison in Syria near Damascus, and they became servants to David, bringing gifts. The Lord kept saving David in all his journeys.

verses.text: David took the golden collars that were upon Adraazar’s servants and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: David took the golden collars that were upon Adraazar’s servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.text: From Metabechas and from Adraazar’s choice cities David took a very great amount of bronze. From it Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the bronze vessels.
verses.display_text: From Metabechas and from Adraazar’s choice cities David took a very great amount of bronze. From it Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the bronze vessels.

verses.text: Thoa king of Hemath heard that David had struck the entire force of Adraazar king of Souba.
verses.display_text: Thoa king of Hemath heard that David had struck the entire force of Adraazar king of Souba.

verses.text: He sent his son Idouram to King David to inquire after his peace and to bless him because he had fought Adraazar and struck him, for Thoa was a hostile man toward Adraazar. With him were all the silver and gold vessels.
verses.display_text: He sent his son Idouram to King David to inquire after his peace and to bless him because he had fought Adraazar and struck him, for Thoa was a hostile man toward Adraazar. With him were all the silver and gold vessels.

verses.text: David consecrated these also to the Lord, with the silver and gold he had taken from all the nations: from Idumea, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the foreigners, and Amalek.
verses.display_text: David consecrated these also to the Lord, with the silver and gold he had taken from all the nations: from Idumea, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the foreigners, and Amalek.

verses.text: Abessa son of Sarouia struck Idumea in the Valley of Salts: eighteen thousand.
verses.display_text: Abessa son of Sarouia struck Idumea in the Valley of Salts: eighteen thousand.

verses.text: He placed garrisons in the valley, and all the Idumeans became David’s servants. The Lord kept saving David in all his journeys.
verses.display_text: He placed garrisons in the valley, and all the Idumeans became David’s servants. The Lord kept saving David in all his journeys.

verses.text: David reigned over all Israel, and he administered judgment and righteousness for all his people.
verses.display_text: David reigned over all Israel, and he administered judgment and righteousness for all his people.

verses.text: Joab son of Sarouia was over the army, and Josaphat son of Achiloud was recorder.
verses.display_text: Joab son of Sarouia was over the army, and Josaphat son of Achiloud was recorder.

verses.text: Sadok son of Achitob and Achimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Sousa was secretary.
verses.display_text: Sadok son of Achitob and Achimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Sousa was secretary.

verses.text: Banaias son of Jodae was over the Chereththi and the Pheleththi, and David’s sons were the king’s foremost successors.
verses.display_text: Banaias son of Jodae was over the Chereththi and the Pheleththi, and David’s sons were the king’s foremost successors.

verses.text: After these things Naas king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son Anan reigned in his place.
verses.display_text: After these things Naas king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son Anan reigned in his place.

verses.text: David said, “I will show mercy to Anan son of Naas, as his father showed mercy to me.” David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came to the land of the sons of Ammon to comfort him.
verses.display_text: David said, “I will show mercy to Anan son of Naas, as his father showed mercy to me.” David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came to the land of the sons of Ammon to comfort him.

verses.text: The rulers of Ammon said to Anan, “Do you suppose David sent comforters to you to glorify your father before you? Have not his servants come to you so that they might search out the city and spy out the land?”
verses.display_text: The rulers of Ammon said to Anan, “Do you suppose David sent comforters to you to glorify your father before you? Have not his servants come to you so that they might search out the city and spy out the land?”

verses.text: Anan took David’s servants, shaved them, removed half their cloaks up to the fold, and sent them away.
verses.display_text: Anan took David’s servants, shaved them, removed half their cloaks up to the fold, and sent them away.

verses.text: They came to report to David about the men. He sent to meet them because they had been greatly dishonored. The king said, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow, then return.”
verses.display_text: They came to report to David about the men. He sent to meet them because they had been greatly dishonored. The king said, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow, then return.”

verses.text: The sons of Ammon saw that David’s people had been put to shame. Anan and the sons of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen for themselves from Syria of Mesopotamia, Syria of Moocha, and Soba.
verses.display_text: The sons of Ammon saw that David’s people had been put to shame. Anan and the sons of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen for themselves from Syria of Mesopotamia, Syria of Moocha, and Soba.

verses.text: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots for themselves, and the king of Mocha and his people. They came and camped opposite Maidaba. The sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to wage war.
verses.display_text: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots for themselves, and the king of Mocha and his people. They came and camped opposite Maidaba. The sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to wage war.

verses.text: David heard and sent Joab and the whole army of mighty men.
verses.display_text: David heard and sent Joab and the whole army of mighty men.

verses.text: The sons of Ammon came out and arrayed themselves for war beside the city gate. The kings who had come camped by themselves in the plain.
verses.display_text: The sons of Ammon came out and arrayed themselves for war beside the city gate. The kings who had come camped by themselves in the plain.

verses.text: Joab saw that opponents had come to fight him in front and behind. He selected from all the young men of Israel, and they arrayed themselves against the Syrian.
verses.display_text: Joab saw that opponents had come to fight him in front and behind. He selected from all the young men of Israel, and they arrayed themselves against the Syrian.

verses.text: He placed the remainder of the people in the hand of Abessa his brother, and they arrayed themselves opposite the sons of Ammon.
verses.display_text: He placed the remainder of the people in the hand of Abessa his brother, and they arrayed themselves opposite the sons of Ammon.

verses.text: He said, “If the Syrian prevails over me, you shall be my deliverance; and if the sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.
verses.display_text: He said, “If the Syrian prevails over me, you shall be my deliverance; and if the sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.

verses.text: Act courageously, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in His eyes.”
verses.display_text: Act courageously, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in His eyes.”

verses.text: Joab and the people with him arrayed themselves opposite the Syrians for war, and they fled from him.
verses.display_text: Joab and the people with him arrayed themselves opposite the Syrians for war, and they fled from him.

verses.text: The sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, and they too fled before Joab and before Abessa his brother and entered the city. Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: The sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, and they too fled before Joab and before Abessa his brother and entered the city. Joab came to Jerusalem.

verses.text: The Syrian saw that Israel had routed him. He sent messengers, and they brought out the Syrian from beyond the River, with Sophach, chief commander of Adraazar’s force, before them.
verses.display_text: The Syrian saw that Israel had routed him. He sent messengers, and they brought out the Syrian from beyond the River, with Sophach, chief commander of Adraazar’s force, before them.

verses.text: David was informed. He gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, came against them, and arrayed himself against them. The Syrian arrayed himself opposite David, and they fought him.
verses.display_text: David was informed. He gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, came against them, and arrayed himself against them. The Syrian arrayed himself opposite David, and they fought him.

verses.text: The Syrian fled before David. David killed from the Syrian force seven thousand chariot fighters and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he killed Sophach the chief commander of the force.
verses.display_text: The Syrian fled before David. David killed from the Syrian force seven thousand chariot fighters and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he killed Sophach the chief commander of the force.

verses.text: Adraazar’s servants saw that they had fallen before Israel. They made a covenant with David and served him, and the Syrian was no longer willing to help the sons of Ammon.
verses.display_text: Adraazar’s servants saw that they had fallen before Israel. They made a covenant with David and served him, and the Syrian was no longer willing to help the sons of Ammon.

verses.text: In the following year, when the kings went out, Joab led the army’s entire force, and they devastated the country of the sons of Ammon. He came and besieged Rabba, while David remained in Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabba and razed it.
verses.display_text: In the following year, when the kings went out, Joab led the army’s entire force, and they devastated the country of the sons of Ammon. He came and besieged Rabba, while David remained in Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabba and razed it.

verses.text: David took the crown of Molchol their king from his head. Its weight was found to be a talent of gold, with a precious stone in it, and it came upon David’s head. He brought out a very great amount of spoil from the city.
verses.display_text: David took the crown of Molchol their king from his head. Its weight was found to be a talent of gold, with a precious stone in it, and it came upon David’s head. He brought out a very great amount of spoil from the city.

verses.text: He brought out the people who were in it and sawed them apart with saws and iron adzes. David did this to all the sons of Ammon. David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: He brought out the people who were in it and sawed them apart with saws and iron adzes. David did this to all the sons of Ammon. David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.text: After these things there was again war with the foreigners at Gazer. Then Sobochai the Ousathi struck Saphou, one of the sons of the giants, and humbled him.
verses.display_text: After these things there was again war with the foreigners at Gazer. Then Sobochai the Ousathi struck Saphou, one of the sons of the giants, and humbled him.

verses.text: There was again war with the foreigners. Ellanan son of Jair struck Leemi, brother of Goliath the Geththite, whose spear shaft was like a weavers’ beam.
verses.display_text: There was again war with the foreigners. Ellanan son of Jair struck Leemi, brother of Goliath the Geththite, whose spear shaft was like a weavers’ beam.

verses.text: There was again war at Geth. There was a man of extraordinary size whose digits were six and six, twenty-four; he too was descended from giants.
verses.display_text: There was again war at Geth. There was a man of extraordinary size whose digits were six and six, twenty-four; he too was descended from giants.

verses.text: He reproached Israel, and Jonathan son of Samaa, David’s brother, struck him.
verses.display_text: He reproached Israel, and Jonathan son of Samaa, David’s brother, struck him.

verses.text: These belonged to Rapha in Geth. They were four giants in all, and they fell by David’s hand and by the hand of his servants.
verses.display_text: These belonged to Rapha in Geth. They were four giants in all, and they fell by David’s hand and by the hand of his servants.

verses.text: The devil stood in Israel and stirred David to number Israel.
verses.display_text: The devil stood in Israel and stirred David to number Israel.

verses.text: King David said to Joab and the rulers of the force, “Go, number Israel from Bersabee to Dan, and bring the report to me, so that I may know their number.”
verses.display_text: King David said to Joab and the rulers of the force, “Go, number Israel from Bersabee to Dan, and bring the report to me, so that I may know their number.”

verses.text: Joab said, “May the Lord add to His people a hundredfold as many as they are, with my lord the king’s eyes seeing it! All are my lord’s servants. Why does my lord seek this? Let it not become sin for Israel!”
verses.display_text: Joab said, “May the Lord add to His people a hundredfold as many as they are, with my lord the king’s eyes seeing it! All are my lord’s servants. Why does my lord seek this? Let it not become sin for Israel!”

verses.text: The king’s word prevailed over Joab. Joab went out, passed through all Israel’s territory, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: The king’s word prevailed over Joab. Joab went out, passed through all Israel’s territory, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.text: Joab gave David the number of the people’s inspection: all Israel was a million and a hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Judah was four hundred eighty thousand men who drew the sword.
verses.display_text: Joab gave David the number of the people’s inspection: all Israel was a million and a hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Judah was four hundred eighty thousand men who drew the sword.

verses.text: He did not number Levi and Benjamin among them, because the king’s word had overpowered Joab.
verses.display_text: He did not number Levi and Benjamin among them, because the king’s word had overpowered Joab.

verses.text: This matter appeared evil before God, and He struck Israel.
verses.display_text: This matter appeared evil before God, and He struck Israel.

verses.text: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly in doing this thing. Now, I beseech Thee, take away Thy servant’s wickedness, for I have become exceedingly foolish.”
verses.display_text: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly in doing this thing. Now, I beseech Thee, take away Thy servant’s wickedness, for I have become exceedingly foolish.”

verses.text: The Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.text: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am raising three things against you. Choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.’”
verses.display_text: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am raising three things against you. Choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.’”

verses.text: Gad came to David and said to him, “Thus says the Lord: Choose for yourself
verses.display_text: Gad came to David and said to him, “Thus says the Lord: Choose for yourself

verses.text: either three years of famine, or three months of your fleeing before your enemies and your enemies’ sword destroying, or three days of the Lord’s sword and death in the land, with the Lord’s angel destroying throughout Israel’s inheritance. Now consider what word I should answer Him who sent me.”
verses.display_text: either three years of famine, or three months of your fleeing before your enemies and your enemies’ sword destroying, or three days of the Lord’s sword and death in the land, with the Lord’s angel destroying throughout Israel’s inheritance. Now consider what word I should answer Him who sent me.”

verses.text: David said to Gad, “All three press me very hard. I will indeed fall into the Lord’s hands, for His compassions are very many; but I will certainly not fall into human hands.”
verses.display_text: David said to Gad, “All three press me very hard. I will indeed fall into the Lord’s hands, for His compassions are very many; but I will certainly not fall into human hands.”

verses.text: The Lord sent death upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
verses.display_text: The Lord sent death upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

verses.text: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he destroyed, the Lord saw and relented concerning the calamity. He said to the destroying angel, “Let it be enough for you! Relax your hand.” The Lord’s angel was standing at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite.
verses.display_text: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he destroyed, the Lord saw and relented concerning the calamity. He said to the destroying angel, “Let it be enough for you! Relax your hand.” The Lord’s angel was standing at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite.

verses.text: David lifted his eyes and saw the Lord’s angel standing between earth and heaven, with his drawn sword in his hand, stretched over Jerusalem. David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.display_text: David lifted his eyes and saw the Lord’s angel standing between earth and heaven, with his drawn sword in his hand, stretched over Jerusalem. David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

verses.text: David said to God, “Was it not I who ordered the people to be numbered? I am the one who sinned; in doing evil I did evil. But these sheep—what have they done? Lord God, let Thy hand be upon me and my father’s house, and not upon Thy people for destruction, Lord.”
verses.display_text: David said to God, “Was it not I who ordered the people to be numbered? I am the one who sinned; in doing evil I did evil. But these sheep—what have they done? Lord God, let Thy hand be upon me and my father’s house, and not upon Thy people for destruction, Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s angel told Gad to tell David to go up and establish an altar to the Lord at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s angel told Gad to tell David to go up and establish an altar to the Lord at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite.

verses.text: David went up according to Gad’s word, which he had spoken in the Lord’s name.
verses.display_text: David went up according to Gad’s word, which he had spoken in the Lord’s name.

verses.text: Orna turned and saw the king, and his four sons with him were methachabin. Orna was threshing wheat.
verses.display_text: Orna turned and saw the king, and his four sons with him were methachabin. Orna was threshing wheat.

verses.text: David came to Ornan. Orna came out from the threshing floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.
verses.display_text: David came to Ornan. Orna came out from the threshing floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.

verses.text: David said to Orna, “Give me your threshing-floor site, and I will build an altar to the Lord on it. Give it to me for its worth in silver, and the plague will cease from the people.”
verses.display_text: David said to Orna, “Give me your threshing-floor site, and I will build an altar to the Lord on it. Give it to me for its worth in silver, and the plague will cease from the people.”

verses.text: Orna said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do what is good before him. Behold, I give the calves for a whole burnt offering, the plow and the wagons for wood, and the grain for a sacrifice. I give everything.”
verses.display_text: Orna said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do what is good before him. Behold, I give the calves for a whole burnt offering, the plow and the wagons for wood, and the grain for a sacrifice. I give everything.”

verses.text: King David said to Orna, “No! I will surely buy it for its worth in silver. I will not take what is yours for the Lord, to offer a whole burnt offering unto the Lord for nothing.”
verses.display_text: King David said to Orna, “No! I will surely buy it for its worth in silver. I will not take what is yours for the Lord, to offer a whole burnt offering unto the Lord for nothing.”

verses.text: David gave Orna at his site six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.display_text: David gave Orna at his site six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

verses.text: David built an altar there to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and a deliverance offering. He cried to the Lord, and He answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of whole burnt offering, and consumed the whole burnt offering.
verses.display_text: David built an altar there to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and a deliverance offering. He cried to the Lord, and He answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of whole burnt offering, and consumed the whole burnt offering.

verses.text: The Lord spoke to the angel, and he put the sword into its sheath.
verses.display_text: The Lord spoke to the angel, and he put the sword into its sheath.

verses.text: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
verses.display_text: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him at the threshing floor of Orna the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.

verses.text: The Lord’s tent, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of whole burnt offerings were at that time in Bama at Gabaon.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s tent, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of whole burnt offerings were at that time in Bama at Gabaon.

verses.text: David could not go before it to seek God, because he hastened away from the sword of the Lord’s angel.
verses.display_text: David could not go before it to seek God, because he hastened away from the sword of the Lord’s angel.

verses.text: David said, “This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for whole burnt offering for Israel.”
verses.display_text: David said, “This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for whole burnt offering for Israel.”

verses.text: David ordered all the resident foreigners in Israel’s land to be gathered. He appointed quarrymen to cut dressed stones for building a house for God.
verses.display_text: David ordered all the resident foreigners in Israel’s land to be gathered. He appointed quarrymen to cut dressed stones for building a house for God.

verses.text: David prepared much iron for the nails of the doorways and gates and for hinges, and bronze in abundance, beyond weighing.
verses.display_text: David prepared much iron for the nails of the doorways and gates and for hinges, and bronze in abundance, beyond weighing.

verses.text: There were cedar timbers beyond counting, because the Sidonians and Tyrians brought cedar timbers to David in abundance.
verses.display_text: There were cedar timbers beyond counting, because the Sidonians and Tyrians brought cedar timbers to David in abundance.

verses.text: David said, “My son Solomon is a tender child, and the house to be built for the Lord must rise to greatness, renowned and glorious throughout all the earth. I will prepare for it.” David prepared in abundance before his death.
verses.display_text: David said, “My son Solomon is a tender child, and the house to be built for the Lord must rise to greatness, renowned and glorious throughout all the earth. I will prepare for it.” David prepared in abundance before his death.

verses.text: He called Solomon his son and commanded him to build the house for the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.display_text: He called Solomon his son and commanded him to build the house for the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.text: David said to Solomon, “Child, it came upon my soul to build a house for the name of the Lord God.
verses.display_text: David said to Solomon, “Child, it came upon my soul to build a house for the name of the Lord God.

verses.text: But the Lord’s word came upon me, saying, ‘You have poured out much blood and waged great wars. You shall not build a house for My name, because you have poured out much blood upon the earth before Me.
verses.display_text: But the Lord’s word came upon me, saying, ‘You have poured out much blood and waged great wars. You shall not build a house for My name, because you have poured out much blood upon the earth before Me.

verses.text: Behold, a son is born unto you; he shall be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all the enemies round about him, for Solomon is his name; and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.display_text: Behold, a son is born unto you; he shall be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all the enemies round about him, for Solomon is his name; and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

verses.text: He will build a house for My name. He will be a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him. I will set upright the throne of his kingdom in Israel for ever.’
verses.display_text: He will build a house for My name. He will be a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him. I will set upright the throne of his kingdom in Israel for ever.’

verses.text: Now, my son, the Lord will be with you, and He will grant success, and you will build a house for the Lord your God, as He spoke concerning you.
verses.display_text: Now, my son, the Lord will be with you, and He will grant success, and you will build a house for the Lord your God, as He spoke concerning you.

verses.text: Only may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and strengthen you over Israel, to observe and to do the law of the Lord your God.
verses.display_text: Only may the Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and strengthen you over Israel, to observe and to do the law of the Lord your God.

verses.text: Then He will grant success, if you take care to do the ordinances and judgments that the Lord commanded Moses concerning Israel. Act courageously and be strong; do not fear or be terrified.
verses.display_text: Then He will grant success, if you take care to do the ordinances and judgments that the Lord commanded Moses concerning Israel. Act courageously and be strong; do not fear or be terrified.

verses.text: Behold, according to my poverty I have prepared for the Lord’s house a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver, with bronze and iron beyond weighing because there is so much. I have also prepared timber and stones; add to these.
verses.display_text: Behold, according to my poverty I have prepared for the Lord’s house a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver, with bronze and iron beyond weighing because there is so much. I have also prepared timber and stones; add to these.

verses.text: With you are workers in abundance: artisans, builders in stone, carpenters in wood, and everyone skilled in every kind of work.
verses.display_text: With you are workers in abundance: artisans, builders in stone, carpenters in wood, and everyone skilled in every kind of work.

verses.text: In gold, in silver, in bronze, and in iron, there is no counting. Arise and act, and the Lord be with you.”
verses.display_text: In gold, in silver, in bronze, and in iron, there is no counting. Arise and act, and the Lord be with you.”

verses.text: David commanded all the rulers of Israel to support Solomon his son:
verses.display_text: David commanded all the rulers of Israel to support Solomon his son:

verses.text: “Is not the Lord with you? He has given you rest on every side, for He has given the land’s inhabitants into hands, and the land has been subjected before the Lord and before His people.
verses.display_text: “Is not the Lord with you? He has given you rest on every side, for He has given the land’s inhabitants into hands, and the land has been subjected before the Lord and before His people.

verses.text: Now give your hearts and your souls to seek the Lord your God. Arise and build a sanctuary for the Lord your God, to bring the ark of the Lord’s covenant and God’s holy vessels into the house being built for the Lord’s name.”
verses.display_text: Now give your hearts and your souls to seek the Lord your God. Arise and build a sanctuary for the Lord your God, to bring the ark of the Lord’s covenant and God’s holy vessels into the house being built for the Lord’s name.”

verses.text: He gathered all Israel’s rulers, the priests, and the Levites.
verses.display_text: He gathered all Israel’s rulers, the priests, and the Levites.

verses.text: The Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward. Their number, counting the men head by head, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.display_text: The Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward. Their number, counting the men head by head, was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.text: Of these, twenty-four thousand were supervisors over the works of the Lord’s house, and six thousand were scribes and judges.
verses.display_text: Of these, twenty-four thousand were supervisors over the works of the Lord’s house, and six thousand were scribes and judges.

verses.text: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments that he made for praising the Lord.
verses.display_text: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments that he made for praising the Lord.

verses.display_text: The sons of Semei: Jeth, Ziza, Joas, and Beria. These were Semei’s sons—four.

verses.text: Eleazar’s sons were found to have more rulers of the mighty men than Ithamar’s sons. He divided them: sixteen rulers of ancestral houses for Eleazar’s sons, and eight according to ancestral houses for Ithamar’s sons.

verses.text: David assembled in Jerusalem all Israel’s rulers: the rulers of the judges, the rulers of the service courses attending the king’s person, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the treasury keepers, those over his possessions, the powerful men, and the army’s warriors.
verses.display_text: David assembled in Jerusalem all Israel’s rulers: the rulers of the judges, the rulers of the service courses attending the king’s person, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the treasury keepers, those over his possessions, the powerful men, and the army’s warriors.

verses.text: David stood in the midst of the assembly and said, “Hear me, brethren and my people. It came upon my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the Lord’s covenant and a standing place for our Lord’s feet, and I prepared the things suitable for the dwelling.
verses.display_text: David stood in the midst of the assembly and said, “Hear me, brethren and my people. It came upon my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the Lord’s covenant and a standing place for our Lord’s feet, and I prepared the things suitable for the dwelling.

verses.text: But God said, ‘You shall not build Me a house to have My name called upon it, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.’
verses.display_text: But God said, ‘You shall not build Me a house to have My name called upon it, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.’

verses.text: The Lord, the God of Israel, chose me from all my father’s house to be king over Israel for ever. He chose the royal power in Judah, and from Judah’s house my father’s house, and among my father’s sons He was willing that I become king over all Israel.
verses.display_text: The Lord, the God of Israel, chose me from all my father’s house to be king over Israel for ever. He chose the royal power in Judah, and from Judah’s house my father’s house, and among my father’s sons He was willing that I become king over all Israel.

verses.text: From all my sons—for the Lord gave me many sons—He chose Solomon my son to seat him upon the throne of the Lord’s kingdom over Israel.
verses.display_text: From all my sons—for the Lord gave me many sons—He chose Solomon my son to seat him upon the throne of the Lord’s kingdom over Israel.

verses.text: God said to me, ‘Solomon your son will build My house and My court, for I have chosen him to be My son, and I will be a Father to him,
verses.display_text: God said to me, ‘Solomon your son will build My house and My court, for I have chosen him to be My son, and I will be a Father to him,

verses.text: and I will set his kingdom upright for ever, if he remains strong to observe My commandments and My judgments, as on this day.’
verses.display_text: and I will set his kingdom upright for ever, if he remains strong to observe My commandments and My judgments, as on this day.’

verses.text: Now, before the whole assembly of the Lord and in the ears of our God, observe and seek all the commandments of the Lord our God, so that you may inherit the good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your sons after you for ever.
verses.display_text: Now, before the whole assembly of the Lord and in the ears of our God, observe and seek all the commandments of the Lord our God, so that you may inherit the good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your sons after you for ever.

verses.text: And now, Solomon my son, know the God of your fathers, and serve Him with a whole heart and a willing soul; for the Lord examines every heart and knows every thought. If you seek Him, He shall be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you utterly.
verses.display_text: And now, Solomon my son, know the God of your fathers, and serve Him with a whole heart and a willing soul; for the Lord examines every heart and knows every thought. If you seek Him, He shall be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you utterly.

verses.text: See, therefore, that the Lord has chosen you to build Him a house as a sanctuary. Be strong and act.”
verses.display_text: See, therefore, that the Lord has chosen you to build Him a house as a sanctuary. Be strong and act.”

verses.text: David gave Solomon his son the pattern of the temple, its houses, its zakcho, its upper rooms, its inner storerooms, and the house of propitiation;
verses.display_text: David gave Solomon his son the pattern of the temple, its houses, its zakcho, its upper rooms, its inner storerooms, and the house of propitiation;

verses.text: and the pattern he had in his spirit: the courts of the Lord’s house, all the surrounding chambers for the storerooms of the Lord’s house, and the storerooms of the holy things;
verses.display_text: and the pattern he had in his spirit: the courts of the Lord’s house, all the surrounding chambers for the storerooms of the Lord’s house, and the storerooms of the holy things;

verses.text: and the lodgings of the priests’ and Levites’ service courses for all the work of ministry in the Lord’s house, and the storerooms of the service vessels for worship in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: and the lodgings of the priests’ and Levites’ service courses for all the work of ministry in the Lord’s house, and the storerooms of the service vessels for worship in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: He gave the measure of their weight, both the gold and the silver ones;
verses.display_text: He gave the measure of their weight, both the gold and the silver ones;

verses.text: he gave him the weight of the lampstands and of the lamps.
verses.display_text: he gave him the weight of the lampstands and of the lamps.

verses.text: Likewise he gave him the weight of the tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise of the silver ones;
verses.display_text: Likewise he gave him the weight of the tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise of the silver ones;

verses.text: and of the meat hooks, libation vessels, and golden bowls, and the weight of the gold and silver ones, kephphoure of each weight.
verses.display_text: and of the meat hooks, libation vessels, and golden bowls, and the weight of the gold and silver ones, kephphoure of each weight.

verses.text: He showed him the weight of the incense altar of tested gold, and the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim with outspread wings, overshadowing the ark of the Lord’s covenant.
verses.display_text: He showed him the weight of the incense altar of tested gold, and the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim with outspread wings, overshadowing the ark of the Lord’s covenant.

verses.text: David gave Solomon everything in writing from the Lord’s hand, according to the understanding that had come to him about carrying out the pattern.
verses.display_text: David gave Solomon everything in writing from the Lord’s hand, according to the understanding that had come to him about carrying out the pattern.

verses.text: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong, be of good courage, and act. Do not fear or be dismayed, for the Lord my God is with you. He will not let you go nor forsake you, until you finish all the work of ministry in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong, be of good courage, and act. Do not fear or be dismayed, for the Lord my God is with you. He will not let you go nor forsake you, until you finish all the work of ministry in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: Behold, the service courses of the priests and Levites are ready for all ministry in God’s house, and are with you in every undertaking, together with everyone eager and wise in every craft. The rulers and all the people are ready for all your words.”
verses.display_text: Behold, the service courses of the priests and Levites are ready for all ministry in God’s house, and are with you in every undertaking, together with everyone eager and wise in every craft. The rulers and all the people are ready for all your words.”

verses.text: King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one whom the Lord has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great, for the building is for the Lord God, not for a human being.
verses.display_text: King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one whom the Lord has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great, for the building is for the Lord God, not for a human being.

verses.text: With all my strength I have prepared for my God’s house gold, silver, bronze, iron, timber, soom stones and filling stones, costly and variegated stones, every precious stone, and much Parian marble.
verses.display_text: With all my strength I have prepared for my God’s house gold, silver, bronze, iron, timber, soom stones and filling stones, costly and variegated stones, every precious stone, and much Parian marble.

verses.text: Moreover, because I delight in my God’s house, I have gold and silver that I have acquired for myself. Behold, I give it to my God’s house in addition, apart from what I have prepared for the house of holy things:
verses.display_text: Moreover, because I delight in my God’s house, I have gold and silver that I have acquired for myself. Behold, I give it to my God’s house in addition, apart from what I have prepared for the house of holy things:

verses.text: three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of tested silver to coat the sanctuary’s walls with them,
verses.display_text: three thousand talents of gold from Souphir and seven thousand talents of tested silver to coat the sanctuary’s walls with them,

verses.text: by the craftsmen’s hand. Who is eager to fill his hands today for the Lord?”
verses.display_text: by the craftsmen’s hand. Who is eager to fill his hands today for the Lord?”

verses.text: The ancestral rulers, the rulers of Israel’s sons, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the overseers of the works, and the king’s stewards offered eagerly.
verses.display_text: The ancestral rulers, the rulers of Israel’s sons, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, the overseers of the works, and the king’s stewards offered eagerly.

verses.text: They gave for the works of the Lord’s house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold coins, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.display_text: They gave for the works of the Lord’s house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold coins, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.text: Those who had a stone gave it to the storerooms of the Lord’s house through Jiiel the Gersoni.
verses.display_text: Those who had a stone gave it to the storerooms of the Lord’s house through Jiiel the Gersoni.

verses.text: The people rejoiced because of their eagerness, for they offered eagerly to the Lord with a full heart. King David rejoiced greatly.
verses.display_text: The people rejoiced because of their eagerness, for they offered eagerly to the Lord with a full heart. King David rejoiced greatly.

verses.text: King David blessed the Lord before the assembly, saying, “Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the God of Israel, our Father, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.display_text: King David blessed the Lord before the assembly, saying, “Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the God of Israel, our Father, from everlasting to everlasting.

verses.text: Thine, O Lord, are greatness, power, glory, victory, and strength; for Thou rulest all things in heaven and upon earth. Before Thee every king and nation is shaken.
verses.display_text: Thine, O Lord, are greatness, power, glory, victory, and strength; for Thou rulest all things in heaven and upon earth. Before Thee every king and nation is shaken.

verses.text: From Thee come wealth and glory. Thou governest all, O Lord, Ruler of every rule. In Thy hand are strength and dominion; and it is in Thy hand, O Almighty, to make all things great and strong.
verses.display_text: From Thee come wealth and glory. Thou governest all, O Lord, Ruler of every rule. In Thy hand are strength and dominion; and it is in Thy hand, O Almighty, to make all things great and strong.

verses.text: Now, O Lord, we give thanks unto Thee, and praise the name of Thy glory.
verses.display_text: Now, O Lord, we give thanks unto Thee, and praise the name of Thy glory.

verses.text: Who am I, and who are my people, that we had strength to offer willingly unto Thee in this manner? All things are Thine, and of Thine own have we given unto Thee.
verses.display_text: Who am I, and who are my people, that we had strength to offer willingly unto Thee in this manner? All things are Thine, and of Thine own have we given unto Thee.

verses.text: For we are resident strangers before Thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days upon earth are as a shadow, and there is no endurance.
verses.display_text: For we are resident strangers before Thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days upon earth are as a shadow, and there is no endurance.

verses.text: Lord our God, all this abundance that I have prepared for a house to be built for Thy holy name is from Thy hand, and everything is Thine.
verses.display_text: Lord our God, all this abundance that I have prepared for a house to be built for Thy holy name is from Thy hand, and everything is Thine.

verses.text: I know, Lord, that Thou examinest hearts and lovest righteousness. In simplicity of heart I eagerly offered all these things. Now I have seen Thy people found here offer eagerly to Thee in gladness.
verses.display_text: I know, Lord, that Thou examinest hearts and lovest righteousness. In simplicity of heart I eagerly offered all these things. Now I have seen Thy people found here offer eagerly to Thee in gladness.

verses.text: Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel our fathers, preserve these things for ever in the thought of Thy people’s heart, and direct their hearts toward Thee.
verses.display_text: Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel our fathers, preserve these things for ever in the thought of Thy people’s heart, and direct their hearts toward Thee.

verses.text: Give Solomon my son a good heart to do Thy commandments, testimonies, and ordinances, and to bring the construction of Thy house to completion.”
verses.display_text: Give Solomon my son a good heart to do Thy commandments, testimonies, and ordinances, and to bring the construction of Thy house to completion.”

verses.text: David said to the whole assembly, “Bless the Lord your God.” The whole assembly blessed the Lord, the God of their fathers. Bending their knees, they prostrated themselves before the Lord and the king.
verses.display_text: David said to the whole assembly, “Bless the Lord your God.” The whole assembly blessed the Lord, the God of their fathers. Bending their knees, they prostrated themselves before the Lord and the king.

verses.text: On the day after the first day David sacrificed sacrifices to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God: a thousand calves, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.display_text: On the day after the first day David sacrificed sacrifices to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God: a thousand calves, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

verses.text: They ate and drank before the Lord that day with joy. They made Solomon son of David king a second time and anointed him for the Lord as king, and Sadok for priesthood.
verses.display_text: They ate and drank before the Lord that day with joy. They made Solomon son of David king a second time and anointed him for the Lord as king, and Sadok for priesthood.

verses.text: Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father and was accepted with favor. All Israel obeyed him.
verses.display_text: Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father and was accepted with favor. All Israel obeyed him.

verses.text: The rulers, the powerful men, and all the sons of King David his father submitted to him.
verses.display_text: The rulers, the powerful men, and all the sons of King David his father submitted to him.

verses.text: The Lord made Solomon exceedingly great before all Israel and gave him a king’s glory such as had not belonged to any king before him.
verses.display_text: The Lord made Solomon exceedingly great before all Israel and gave him a king’s glory such as had not belonged to any king before him.

verses.text: David son of Jessai reigned over Israel
verses.display_text: David son of Jessai reigned over Israel

verses.text: for forty years: in Chebron seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
verses.display_text: for forty years: in Chebron seven years, and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.

verses.text: He died in a good old age, full of days, wealth, and glory. Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.display_text: He died in a good old age, full of days, wealth, and glory. Solomon his son reigned in his place.

verses.text: The remaining deeds of King David, the earlier and the later, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet, and the records of Gad the seer,
verses.display_text: The remaining deeds of King David, the earlier and the later, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet, and the records of Gad the seer,

verses.text: concerning all his kingdom and dominion, and the times that came upon him, upon Israel, and upon all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.display_text: concerning all his kingdom and dominion, and the times that came upon him, upon Israel, and upon all the kingdoms of the earth.
